description.value: Dockside Restaurant sits on the waterfront of Granville Island inside the Granville Island Hotel, offering panoramic views of False Creek, the Vancouver skyline, and the North Shore Mountains through floor-to-ceiling windows. The award-winning patio spans over 200 seats and is one of the city's most celebrated outdoor dining spaces. A seasonal menu of fresh, locally sourced ingredients with international influences is served across breakfast, lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch.
